experiment: Track B four-outer-fold technical-news paired ablation
training_scope: 2019 through test_year-1; identical rows for technical and technical+news arms
sentiment_prediction_contract: expanding labelled inference for 2019-2023; frozen through 2023 for both 2024 and 2025; no pseudo-label retraining
scaling: MinMaxScaler fit separately on each fold train only
boundary_context: feature-only rows between supervised train and test are included in test sequences but excluded from model fitting
runtime_scope: fit_runtime_seconds_sum is the sum of model build, fit, and evaluation inference time; process startup and report recovery are excluded
